is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 6, section 3.1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (1014F), Vgsc L995S (1014S), Vgsc N1575Y (N1570Y), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) (page 5, section 2.8; page 9, section 3.5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts and frequencies are provided for 1014F (fixed), 1014S (all SS), N1575Y (11 heterozygotes, 33 homozygous susceptible), and G119S (23 RR, 22 SS) (page 9, section 3.5; page 10, Table 2).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Mangoum, Cameroon (page 3, section 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting field collections, bioassays, and molecular analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study location is Mangoum, Cameroon (page 3, section 2.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted in November 2020 and May 2021 (page 3, section 2.1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and analysis for the Mangoum site.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigates insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.s. from Mangoum, Cameroon. It reports high resistance to multiple insecticide classes, including pyrethroids, carbamates, and organophosphates. Genotyping revealed fixed 1014F-kdr, moderate frequencies of 1575Y-kdr and G119S-Ace-1, and overexpression of several metabolic and cuticular resistance genes.
